comment: The section correctly explains that implementable architectures need profiles covering data structures, actors, transactions, and interfaces. However, it does not identify the complete set of implementation artefacts countries should produce.

anchor.note: p.94 l.Lines 249-254 read as the printed page; section 4.3 agrees

public.text: The section correctly explains that implementable architectures need profiles covering data structures, actors, transactions, and interfaces. However, it does not identify the complete set of implementation artefacts countries should produce.
public.suggestedRevision: Add a minimum implementation-package checklist covering logical models, implementation guides, terminology bindings, actor definitions, capability statements, API specifications, security profiles, workflow specifications, test cases, test data, deployment guidance, and versioning policies.
